set.body: Found while writing AoiLaws (2026-09-17). AoiAssignment.measure in aoi/Aoi.scala ends a run on any non-member sample, including excluded Lost/Blink support, so two fixations inside the same AOI separated by a positive-duration saccade count as two runs (runCount == number of maximal abutting blocks of contained fixations). The aoi-set ticket text assumed runs <= 1 when all fixations are inside, which only holds when contained fixations abut. eyesim and most AOI literature count a visit as surviving the saccade that lands in the same AOI. Owner decision: keep sample-level runs (document it) or make runs fixation-level (a code change plus a law change in laws/AoiLaws.scala 'blocks').
set.title: Decision: does an AOI visit survive a saccade or blink between contained fixations?
